title: Millhaven - A Village That Carries On
objective: Help Millhaven recover: ask Torvin to retrieve the borrowed shovel, receive it at your agreed meeting place, then arrange a real well-digging crew behind Elsie's tavern. When the mill drive fails at 14:00, ask Hobb to repair it with Mara and let the grain-to-flour-to-bread trade resume. Use village_ask, village_request, village_tell and village_wait to cooperate with the residents. Drop supplies at the crew's location; tell them only locations you actually know. Task progress is verified by the engine, never by dialogue.
opening_narrative:
At eight in the morning, Millhaven is already awake. A hammer rings from Torvin's forge, flour dust drifts above Mara's watermill, and Elsie props open the tavern door. Beyond the square, a farm track, a stable lane and a path toward the river invite a closer look.

Elsie hopes for a well behind the tavern. Torvin remembers lending his shovel to Bren, but borrowed tools have a way of travelling. Ask the villagers what they know, offer practical help, and let them get on with their work. Their information may be old; their actions still have to happen in the real village.

Each ordinary action gives the village five minutes. Looking and reading cost no time. A longer wait lets people travel, produce goods and carry out accepted requests without further orders.

body.description: A visiting helper with two hands and room for four inventory units.

village-square.name: Village square
village-square.description: A noticeboard stands beside the pump. Paths lead to the forge, stable, tavern, general store and farm.

forge.name: Torvin's forge
forge.description: Torvin's anvil stands beside a wagon awaiting repairs. His tools are private: ask him to help rather than taking them.

stable.name: Bren's stable
stable.description: Horses shift in straw-lined stalls. Bren keeps track of tools lent around the village.

watermill.name: Mara's watermill
watermill.description: Grain is ground here into flour. The drive is old; repairs need a carpenter, a miller, a replacement beam and a hammer.

mill-shed.name: Mill shed
mill-shed.description: A dry shed for borrowed tools and sacks beside the watermill.

farm.name: Ada's farm
farm.description: Fields and a grain store supply the mill. Grain must actually be carried there by the village merchant.

general-store.name: Nella's general store
general-store.description: A counter lists local stock prices. Nella also walks the grain, flour and bread delivery circuit.

workshop.name: Hobb's workshop
workshop.description: Hobb keeps a replacement mill beam and joiner's tools here. Ask him about repair work.

tavern.name: Elsie's tavern
tavern.description: Elsie serves villagers with bread from Jory's bakery. At nineteen hundred the workers gather here to share witnessed news.

bakery.name: Jory's bakery
bakery.description: Jory turns local flour into bread. Without flour deliveries the oven cannot produce another loaf.

cottages.name: Village cottages
cottages.description: Shared courtyards and modest homes. Most villagers return here at night.

woods.name: Rowan's woodlot
woods.description: Managed woodland supplies timber from a finite stock of felled logs.

bridge.name: Stone bridge
bridge.description: Garrick watches the river crossing. The mill, woodlot and fishing bank lie beyond.

riverbank.name: Fishing bank
riverbank.description: Finn fishes while Iona gathers herbs nearby. The path returns over the bridge.

tavern-yard.name: Ground behind the tavern
tavern-yard.description: A marked safe well site. Torvin and Bren need the actual shovel, rope and timber to complete the digging.

square-forge.description: A short walk between the square and forge.

square-stable.name: Stable lane
square-stable.description: A short walk between the square and stable.

square-store.name: Market walk
square-store.description: The store opens onto the square.

square-farm.description: A broad track to the farm.

square-bridge.name: River road

bridge-mill.description: A path from the bridge to the mill.

mill-shed-path.name: Shed path
mill-shed-path.description: A short path from the mill into the shed.

bridge-woods.name: Woodlot trail
bridge-woods.description: A trail from the bridge to the woodlot.

bridge-river.name: Fishing path
bridge-river.description: A path from the bridge to the fishing bank.

tavern-yard-gate.description: An open gate to the ground behind the tavern.

stable-shed.description: A public footpath between the stable and mill shed.

farm-mill.name: Grain road
farm-mill.description: A delivery road from the farm to the mill.

mill-bakery.name: Flour lane
mill-bakery.description: A delivery lane from the mill to the bakery.

bakery-tavern.description: A delivery walk between bakery and tavern.

torvin.name: Torvin

bren.name: Bren
bren.description: A patient stable keeper who notices where borrowed equipment goes.

mara.name: Mara
mara.description: A methodical miller concerned about the aging mill drive.

elsie.name: Elsie
elsie.description: A welcoming innkeeper who wants a well behind her tavern.

hobb.name: Hobb
hobb.description: A careful carpenter who will coordinate repairs with Mara.

jory.name: Jory
jory.description: A baker whose bread depends on actual flour deliveries.

ada.name: Ada

nella.name: Nella

rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.description: A forester managing a finite stock of felled logs.

garrick.name: Garrick
garrick.description: A watchful guard who patrols between the bridge and square.

iona.name: Iona

finn.name: Finn
finn.description: A fisher tending lines on the riverbank.

shovel.name: Torvin's shovel
shovel.description: A sound iron shovel, moved here after Bren lent it for clearing the mill race.

well-timber.name: Well lining timber
well-timber.description: Prepared timber reserved for Elsie's well.

well-rope.name: Well safety rope
well-rope.description: A sound rope reserved for the well crew.

mill-beam.name: Replacement mill beam
mill-beam.description: A prepared replacement drive beam reserved for Mara's mill.

joiner-hammer.name: Hobb's hammer
joiner-hammer.description: A joiner's hammer for installing the replacement beam.

mill-drive.name: Old mill drive
mill-drive.description: An aging mechanism that must turn for flour production. Hobb and Mara can repair it with the proper supplies.

noticeboard.name: Village noticeboard
noticeboard.description: A public guide to the village's needs.
noticeboard.readable_text: Elsie requests a well behind the tavern. Torvin and Bren can dig with shovel, lining timber and safety rope. Torvin is finishing urgent wagon work until 08:30. Ask him about the borrowed shovel and meet him where you made the request. Hobb keeps a replacement mill beam and hammer at his workshop; Mara must help with repairs if the old drive fails. Visit workplaces to trade posted stock. At 19:00 most residents gather at the tavern, then go home at 22:00. Looking and reading are free; other actions take five minutes. Use village_wait for longer periods.

price-board.name: Store price board
price-board.readable_text: Per unit: grain 1, flour 2, bread 3, iron 3, wagon-parts 5, hay 1, manure 1, logs 1, timber 2, planks 3, herbs 1, tea 2, fish 2, meals 4 coins. Resource stock is accounted separately from portable tools. The visitor starts with 20 coins.

horseshoe.name: Spare horseshoe
horseshoe.description: A horseshoe laid aside for the stable.

millstones.name: Millstones
millstones.description: Heavy stones driven by the mill mechanism.

rake.name: Mill race rake
rake.description: A rake used to clear the mill race.

seed-box.name: Seed box
seed-box.description: An empty box for next season's seed.

ledger.name: Delivery ledger
ledger.description: A public explanation of the delivery circuit.
ledger.readable_text: Nella collects grain at Ada's farm, sells it to Mara at the mill, carries Mara's flour to Jory, then brings Jory's bread to Elsie. Each delivery takes real walking time. Empty stock or insufficient coins blocks a trade; no stock appears by narration.

water-jug.name: Water jug
water-jug.description: A jug filled from the old square pump.

guest-book.name: Guest book
guest-book.description: A book by the tavern door.
guest-book.readable_text: Welcome to Millhaven. Elsie invites willing volunteers to discuss a well behind the tavern; nobody is obliged to abandon urgent work.

flour-scoop.name: Flour scoop
flour-scoop.description: A scoop beside the flour store.

fishing-net.name: Fishing net
fishing-net.description: A net drying by the bank.

mortar.name: Healer's mortar
mortar.description: A stone mortar for preparing herbs.

torvin.personality: Practical and proud of keeping promises; urgent wagon repairs come first.

bren.personality: Patient and helpful once the horses are fed.

mara.personality: Methodical; concerned about grain deliveries and the old mill drive.

elsie.personality: Welcoming but careful with the tavern budget; would love a reliable well.

hobb.personality: Careful and willing to help Mara, but only with the right materials.

jory.personality: Cheerful until the flour bin runs empty.

ada.personality: Steady and early-rising; expects payment for deliveries.

nella.personality: Resourceful and exact about stock and payment.

rowan.personality: Quiet and protective of the managed woodlot.

garrick.personality: Watchful; reports only what he has witnessed.

iona.personality: Considerate and unwilling to invent news she has not heard.

finn.personality: Easygoing and fond of evening company.
